brief: inline dispatch: critique the wave-1 save/load repair against RI-JRN05
outputs_written: tools/harness/save-break-critic.mjs (NEW - four breaks asking which shipped instrument notices)
findings: VERDICT: 2/10, FAIL, HF1 triggered. RI-JRN05 native 2/100.

HF1 (a): pose.camera_death_frames_ago collapses to the -1 'never died' sentinel. save/state.js:356 tests `c.deathFrame < 0` while restoreCameraRig (state.js:741) legitimately produces a NEGATIVE deathFrame after the frame reset. 24 of 36 death-window trials mismatch on M1, 4 of 4 states, 3-150 frames after death. Reproduced with the BUILDER'S OWN __HARNESS.saveRoundTrip().

HF1 (b): fight.player.pendingReaction.move.clip {'__move':'stagger_medium'} -> null on a save taken on the killing-blow frame. Same wrong-key move-reference class the repair fixed for pose.move and not for the nested one. 4 of 4 states.

BIGGEST GAP GAP-W1-save-purse-has-no-writer: combat.world.gold / sim.stealth.p.gold are the spendable purse and neither is written back to sim.progression.gold, the only gold register the save carries. 3 of the 38 shipped states (helstrom-market, rootlands-well-graph, stormhold-street) lose 600 gold on a plain round trip AND on a real cold reload, with M1 equal, M2 empty, M4 empty both ways, census ok and the M5 trace byte-identical. Null control: blanking the field out of the blob produces the identical world = CONSUMPTION coupling 0.

AR-2 FAIL: combat/parley.js:97 tests (world.gold||0) >= enemy.parley.gold_price as the GOLD ground of ARBITRATION section 1's mandatory non-lethal exit. inf_trash gold_price 180; 600 gold before the save, 0 after. Also S6: a save inside the death sequence does not round-trip, and death.controllable_at is restored unrebased so surface_frames_left goes 137 -> 161.

76/76 does NOT survive. My instrument: 9 scenarios x 10 seeds = 90 trials. mid-death 0/10 and mid-crime 0/10; the other seven scenarios 10/10 clean (incl. mid-cast, mid-parry, save inside an active hitbox window). Seeds were never the weakness - the builder's ONE pre-roll applied to all 38 states was.

MID-AIR SAVE IS LETHAL: 40 m fall, 3 seeds x both arm orders = 6/6. Control lands hp 620; saved-and-loaded mid-air lands hp 0. engine.magic.airborne / magic.fall.velMps / magic.peakY are a SECOND fall model on no manifest row. The post-load trace is byte-identical, so M5 is blind to it.

IDENTITY FIELDS: 7 of 9 carry information and are restored. traversal.breath_s stays 60.0 and submerged stays false after 3,000 frames in 40.3 m of water (band W5) - the character floats, so the repair's headline drowning claim describes an unreachable state. player.burdenRatio is derived (recomputed every step by _recomputeBurden) so saving it is neither right nor wrong.

NEGATIVE EVIDENCE FOR THE BUILDER: the traversal restore IS real (perturb-then-load puts breath 3.25 -> 60, mire 0.77 -> 0, slide 4.5 -> 0 back). M3 - which the builder never ran - PASSES on 4/4 states across a real page reload through IndexedDB. The schema-2 refusal happens before any mutation. save-break.mjs re-run by me: 8/8, baseline_clean true, all three rewritten breaks genuinely take.

save-break-critic.mjs: of four breaks, no-gold is BLIND to M1, M4 and the census while changing the live world; no-encounter-latches and no-lkp are caught by the census; no-traversal-restore is caught only by M4 and only because I blanked the blob node.

getDurableFieldCensus() shot() walks sim.* + the combat bodies and NOT engine.combat.world, engine.crime, engine.travel, engine.conversation or sim._traversal. Its own comment warns that a census walking a subset certifies a subset. The purse fell into exactly that hole.
rules.dynamic_containers exempts 20 paths from M4 by declaring them leaves, six of them this repair's own additions. Declared honestly, but it means M4 never looks inside the combat body.
No falsification found on the volatile list: it is unchanged from RI-JRN05 section B and nothing was moved onto it.

SCENARIO CONTAMINATION: loadState('<name>') does not clear the fall model. 3 of 5 province scenarios failed my instrument's two-identical-prerolls reproducibility control - one gave a live player in one repeat and a corpse in the other. Any critic running two arms in one page on a province state is measuring contamination unless it checks.

CORPUS DEBT: RI-JRN05's ladder anchor table (Form B, 'Ladder ceiling' column) covers 8/6/5/4 and has no 0 or 2 rung, while its own hard fails cap the item at 2. SCORING section 1.2b requires the 0 and 2 rungs on any item that can produce a score below its ladder-4 anchor.
GAP-W1-platform-save-drops-entity-prev-state: CLOSED. prev_state carried, no post-load divergence on 90/90 trials.
notes_for_successor: The three critic tools live at tools/journey/save-live-audit.mjs, tools/harness/save-consume-critic.mjs and tools/harness/save-break-critic.mjs. save-live-audit's reproducibility control is the important part: three province scenarios are unmeasurable without it and would otherwise read as save defects. For the next builder: the two HF1 causes are one-line-ish (a sentinel that collides with a rebased negative, and a nested move reference resolved by the wrong key); the purse is a three-register authority problem and the census widening is the thing that stops the class recurring.
